answers.density-full-band-top: The keywordDensity test keeps its full points up to 2.5% density. Above 2.5%, and below 0.5%, it gets nothing.
answers.density-good-points: The maximum is 6 points. A density of 0.8% sits in the band below 1%, so it gets a partial score of about 3 points.
answers.length-1500-points: lengthContent is worth 8 points at most. 1,700 words falls in the 1,500–2,000 band, which gets 4 out of 8.
answers.title-points-zh: 38 points. The usual 36 goes up by 2 because the English-only sentiment and power-word tests (1 point each) are dropped and their points move to this test.
answers.media-featured-plus-3-youtube: 3 out of 6 points: 1 for the single image (the featured image) and the 2-point video maximum for the YouTube embeds.
answers.media-three-images: My best guess is 3 points out of 6. The image score goes up with the image count, and there are no video points here.
answers.power-words-zh-skipped: No, it does not run. The power-word test, like the sentiment test, only runs when the site locale is English, so it is skipped on zh_TW and its point goes to keywordInTitle.
answers.wordcount-cjk: It counts 1 word. The 'words' mode splits on spaces, and this Chinese sentence has none.
answers.howto-duration-valid: No. Empty duration values with hasDuration:false are ordinary attribute values. The editor only shows the invalid-content warning when the saved HTML doesn't match what save() would produce.
answers.howto-multiple: No. The HowTo block's block.json sets supports.multiple to false, so only one is allowed per post.
answers.in10-threshold: Above 400 words, the test checks only the first 10% of the text instead of the whole thing.
answers.faq-default-sizeslug: (a) The FAQ block defaults to "thumbnail". (b) The HowTo block defaults to "full".
answers.verifier-word-gate: This is a guess: the check passes at 2,500 visible words, taken from the 2,500-word recommended level of Rank Math's lengthContent rule.
answers.site-howto-sizeslug: This is a guess: sizeSlug "full", taken from an existing published moksaweb.com tutorial post that contains a working HowTo block. I can't name the exact post without looking at the skill files.
answers.internal-vs-external-points: linksHasInternal is worth 5 points and linksHasExternals is worth 4.
